title: U.S. Coast Guard Air Station Kodiak Conducts Search and Rescue Demonstration during DHS Secretary, USCG Commandant and Alaska Sen. Sullivan visit
description: U.S. Department of Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin, U.S. Coast Guard Adm. Kevin E. Lunday, Commandant of the Coast Guard and U.S. Sen. Dan Sullivan, R-Alaska visited U.S. Coast Guard Air Station Kodiak, Alaska, Aug. 11, 2026. The visit recognized Coast Guard personnel, discussed upcoming changes, and engaged with the workforce and local community on the service’s evolving mission and continued role in safeguarding Alaska and the Arctic. (U.S. Air Force video by Staff Sgt. Christopher Chen)
